page_node_configuration_intro: Set the radio behavior and announcements for this node. Leave a value at its recommended setting unless you need to change it.
wizard_intro: Choose the node identity and a common starting configuration. Nothing is saved until you finish the review.
wizard_error_summary: Review the highlighted fields and correct the problems before continuing.
wizard_display_name_help: A name to help you recognize this node in the manager.
wizard_callsign_help: Used for the initial station ID. You can change the ID recording later in node settings.
wizard_profile_simplex_help: Half duplex with no telemetry tones or hang time.
wizard_profile_hotspot_help: Half duplex with telemetry and hang time; does not repeat audio.
wizard_profile_repeater_help: Full duplex with telemetry, hang time, and repeated audio.
wizard_profile_hub_help: Uses the local pseudo channel and does not require a radio interface.
wizard_radio_interface_help: Choose the channel driver connected to this node. The matching Asterisk module must be enabled on the host.
wizard_review_help: Check these values before creating the node. Setup changes are committed together and configuration is regenerated once.
wizard_review_note: This creates the node with the common starting values shown above. You can adjust its detailed settings after setup.
configuration_source_note: Field descriptions are adapted from the upstream app_rpt configuration examples.
help_rxchannel: Select the audio and signaling interface connected to this node. A hub with no radio uses Local/pseudo. Enable the matching channel driver in modules.conf.
help_duplex: Choose how the node handles transmit, receive, telemetry, and repeated audio. Half duplex suits simplex nodes; full duplex with repeated audio is typical for a repeater.
duplex_option_0: Half duplex, no telemetry tones or hang time
duplex_option_1: Half duplex with telemetry and hang time; do not repeat audio
duplex_option_2: Full duplex with telemetry, hang time, and repeated audio
duplex_option_3: Full duplex with telemetry and hang time; no repeated audio
duplex_option_4: Full duplex; repeat audio only while autopatch is down
help_linktolink: Keep half-duplex behavior while avoiding forced half-duplex operation on the main repeater. Usually leave this off unless the node links two systems directly.
help_linkmongain: Adjust the level of audio from linked nodes when another node or the local receiver is active. Negative values lower the audio; positive values raise it. Zero leaves the level unchanged.
help_hangtime: How long the transmitter remains keyed after the received signal ends. The upstream example uses 5000 milliseconds (5 seconds).
help_althangtime: An alternate, longer squelch-tail hang time used by supported repeater functions. Set to zero when you do not need an alternate delay.
help_totime: Maximum continuous transmit time before app_rpt stops transmission. The upstream example uses 180000 milliseconds (3 minutes).
field_idrecording: Station ID recording or Morse text
help_idrecording: Audio recording or Morse text used to identify the station. The upstream example uses |iNOTSET as the not-configured value.
field_idtalkover: Talk-over ID recording or Morse text
help_idtalkover: Optional ID played over ongoing activity when an identification is due. Leave blank to use no talk-over ID.
help_idtime: Time between routine station identifications. The upstream example uses 300000 milliseconds (5 minutes).
help_politeid: How long before the ID timer expires app_rpt may wait for a suitable moment to identify during a tail. The upstream example uses 30000 milliseconds.
help_context: Asterisk dialplan context used when a phone call accesses this node. The supplied upstream configuration uses the radio context.
help_callerid: Caller ID name and number presented for phone activity on this node.
help_accountcode: Optional account code associated with phone calls through this node.
help_unlinkedct: Tone played when a user unkeys while this node has no remote node links. Leave blank for no tone.
help_remotect: Tone played when a remote linked node is present in the link list.
help_linkunkeyct: Tone played when a transmission received over a link ends.
help_holdofftelem: Delay telemetry while the receiver or a connected node is active, except for an ID that must be sent over connected-node activity.
help_telemdefault: Choose whether telemetry is off, on, or temporarily enabled after command activity.
help_telemdynamic: Allow users to change the current local telemetry mode with a COP command.
help_parrot: When enabled, audio transmitted to the node is played back. Value 1 keeps it on; value 0 leaves it off or available through COP commands.
help_parrottime: Time app_rpt waits before playing back received audio in parrot mode.
help_rxboost: Choose whether the SimpleUSB interface removes its 20 dB input attenuator. Enable this only when the receiver audio output level is low.
help_carrierfrom: Choose how SimpleUSB detects a received carrier: no detection, or the USB interface COR line with normal or inverted polarity.
help_ctcssfrom: Choose how SimpleUSB detects receive CTCSS: disabled (carrier squelch), or the USB interface CTCSS line with normal or inverted polarity.
help_deemphasis: Apply de-emphasis to receiver audio taken from the discriminator.
help_plfilter: Enable the receive PL (CTCSS) filter in the SimpleUSB interface.
field_rxondelay: Receive carrier confirmation delay (20 ms frames)
help_rxondelay: Delay accepting the hardware COR signal after it activates. This can help prevent ping-ponging on simplex nodes; leave at zero for repeaters and full-duplex nodes.
help_txoffdelay: Wait after the transmitter unkeys before accepting hardware COR. This can help a half-duplex link ignore the connected repeater's hang time; leave at zero for normal repeaters.
help_invertptt: Choose whether the PTT output grounds to transmit or opens to transmit.
help_preemphasis: Apply standard 6 dB per octave pre-emphasis to transmit audio.
help_rxmixerset: Set the SimpleUSB receive audio mixer level from 0 to 999. Use a service monitor and the receive level meter while tuning.
help_txmixaset: Set the SimpleUSB transmit audio level on output channel A from 0 to 999.
help_txmixbset: Set the SimpleUSB transmit audio level on output channel B from 0 to 999.
advanced_settings_intro: These options cover less common repeater, timing, identification, telephone, and telemetry behavior. Change them only when you understand their effect.
